# RealpathInStreamContext

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `RealpathInStreamContextInspection`

`realpath()` returns `false` for paths inside stream wrappers such as
`phar://`, so code that works on disk breaks once packaged. Climbing
directories with `realpath(__DIR__ . '/../')` or wrapping include paths in
`realpath()` should use `dirname()` / the plain path instead.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,4,5,6,7} [Before]
<?php
$root = realpath(dirname(__DIR__, 1) . '/../var');
$cfg  = realpath($app . "/../../etc");
$odd  = realpath($app . '/lib' . '/..');
$rel  = realpath('../shared');
require realpath('/opt/app/boot.php');
include_once (realpath($entry));
$ok   = realpath($app . '/cache');
$two  = realpath('/tmp', 'x');
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
$root = dirname(dirname(__DIR__, 1)) . '/var';
$cfg  = dirname(dirname($app)) . "/etc";
$odd  = realpath($app . '/lib' . '/..');
$rel  = realpath('../shared');
require '/opt/app/boot.php';
include_once (realpath($entry));
$ok   = realpath($app . '/cache');
$two  = realpath('/tmp', 'x');
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Use &#39;dirname(dirname(__DIR__, 1)) . &#39;/var&#39;&#39; instead: realpath() fails inside stream wrappers.</li>
<li>line 3: Use &#39;dirname(dirname($app)) . &#34;/etc&#34;&#39; instead: realpath() fails inside stream wrappers.</li>
<li>line 4: realpath() fails inside stream wrappers such as phar://; prefer dirname().</li>
<li>line 5: realpath() fails inside stream wrappers such as phar://; prefer dirname().</li>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;&#39;/opt/app/boot.php&#39;&#39; instead: realpath() fails inside stream wrappers.</li>
<li>line 7: realpath() fails inside stream wrappers such as phar://; prefer dirname().</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "RealpathInStreamContext": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore RealpathInStreamContext

/**
 * @noinspection RealpathInStreamContextInspection
 */
```
